description_zh: 一辆白色 Plymouth Voyager（ego）在红灯路口试图从左侧绕过前方静止的 Lexus 测试车（v1）进入左转车道时，右侧车身擦碰到测试车左后轮传感器，发生侧擦碰撞。天气晴朗，傍晚，路面干燥，施工区。

source_snippets: A test vehicle, stopped at a red light in Sunnyvale while operating in manual mode, was lightly struck on a sensor attached to the rear driver side wheel by a white minivan attempting to maneuver around the vehicle to enter a left turn lane.
MOVEMENT PRECEDING COLLISION: A. STOPPED: VEH 1 (X); I. PASSING OTHER VEHICLE: VEH 2 (X)
TYPE OF COLLISION: B. SIDE SWIPE
WEATHER: A. CLEAR; LIGHTING: A. DAYLIGHT; ROADWAY SURFACE: A. DRY; ROADWAY CONDITIONS: D. CONSTRUCTION – REPAIR ZONE
evidence.reason: 移动的 minivan（ego）试图绕过静止的测试车（v1）进入左转车道时发生侧擦，ego 有主动驾驶决策（超车），测试价值明确；静止车辆用 static_hold + adjacent 表达，符合现有词汇表。
